scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:itch: npm run build && .\butler.exe push dist japeco06/cyber-survivor:html5
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting && .\butler.exe push dist japeco06/cyber-survivor:html5
scripts.package:itch: npm run build && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path cyber-survivor-itch.zip) { Remove-Item cyber-survivor-itch.zip }; Set-Location dist; tar.exe -a -c -f ../cyber-survivor-itch.zip *; Set-Location .."
